It is a fully modular, low-noise power supply with a 150 mm length that delivers up to 1000W and high-efficiency 80 Plus ® Titanium power to your PC build. With the full-bridge LLC topology circuit design and 450V, 105°C Japanese main bulk capacitors, PC parts receive premium power input from HYDRO Ti PRO power supplies. You can also access all the connections from the HYDRO Ti PRO series power supplies for demanding PC upgrades.
